title: Used to, didn't use to (past habits and states) - Past habits and states

options.answer: I use to play football when I was young.
I used to play football when I was young.
I am used to play football when I was young.

explanation.en: We use 'used to' to talk about past habits or states that are no longer true. The correct form is 'used to' + base verb.
explanation.ru: Мы используем 'used to' для выражения прошлых привычек или состояний, которые больше не актуальны. Правильная форма: 'used to' + основа глагола.
explanation.uz: O'tmishda bo'lgan, ammo hozir mavjud bo'lmagan odatlar yoki holatlar haqida gapirish uchun 'used to' ishlatiladi. To'g'ri shakli: 'used to' + fe'lning asosi.

options.answer: She didn't used to like vegetables.
She didn't use to like vegetables.
She not used to like vegetables.

explanation.en: In negative sentences, we use 'didn't use to' (not 'didn't used to'). After 'did/didn't' we use the base form 'use to'.
explanation.ru: В отрицательных предложениях используется 'didn't use to' (не 'didn't used to'). После 'did/didn't' используется основная форма 'use to'.
explanation.uz: Inkor gaplarda 'didn't use to' ishlatiladi ('didn't used to' emas). 'did/didn't'dan keyin 'use to' asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Did you used to live in London?
Did you use to live in London?
Used you to live in London?

explanation.en: In questions, we use 'Did + subject + use to + base verb'. After auxiliary 'did' we use the base form 'use to'.
explanation.ru: В вопросах используется 'Did + подлежащее + use to + основа глагола'. После вспомогательного 'did' используется основная форма 'use to'.
explanation.uz: Savollarda 'Did + ega + use to + fe'lning asosi' ishlatiladi. 'did' yordamchi fe'lidan keyin 'use to' asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

question.en: Choose the correct sentence about past states.
question.ru: Выберите правильное предложение о прошлых состояниях.
question.uz: O'tmishdagi holatlar haqidagi to'g'ri gapni tanlang.

options.answer: There used to be a cinema here.
There use to be a cinema here.
There was used to be a cinema here.

explanation.en: 'Used to' can describe past states that no longer exist. 'There used to be' is the correct structure for describing places or things that existed before.
explanation.ru: 'Used to' может описывать прошлые состояния, которые больше не существуют. 'There used to be' - правильная структура для описания мест или вещей, которые существовали раньше.
explanation.uz: 'Used to' endi mavjud bo'lmagan o'tmishdagi holatlarni tasvirlaydi. 'There used to be' - avval mavjud bo'lgan joylar yoki narsalarni tasvirlash uchun to'g'ri struktura.

question.ru: В каком предложении правильно используется 'used to'?

options.answer: My grandmother used to tell me stories every night.
My grandmother used to told me stories every night.
My grandmother used to telling me stories every night.

explanation.en: 'Used to' is followed by the base form of the verb. We say 'used to tell', not 'used to told' or 'used to telling'.
explanation.ru: После 'used to' используется основная форма глагола. Говорим 'used to tell', а не 'used to told' или 'used to telling'.
explanation.uz: 'Used to'dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi. 'used to tell' deyiladi, 'used to told' yoki 'used to telling' emas.

options.answer: We didn't used to have a car.
We didn't use to have a car.
We usedn't to have a car.

explanation.en: The negative form of 'used to' is 'didn't use to'. We use the base form 'use to' after the auxiliary 'didn't'.
explanation.ru: Отрицательная форма 'used to' - это 'didn't use to'. После вспомогательного 'didn't' используется основная форма 'use to'.
explanation.uz: 'used to'ning inkor shakli 'didn't use to' hisoblanadi. 'didn't' yordamchi fe'lidan keyin 'use to' asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

options.answer: What did you use to do in summer?
What did you used to do in summer?
What you used to do in summer?

explanation.en: In wh-questions with 'used to', we use 'did + subject + use to + base verb'. The auxiliary 'did' requires the base form 'use to'.
explanation.ru: В специальных вопросах с 'used to' используется 'did + подлежащее + use to + основа глагола'. Вспомогательный 'did' требует основную форму 'use to'.
explanation.uz: 'used to' bilan maxsus savollarda 'did + ega + use to + fe'lning asosi' ishlatiladi. 'did' yordamchi fe'li 'use to' asosiy shaklini talab qiladi.
